page.overview:
Who is Gary Gygax?

Gary Gygax co-designed Dungeons & Dragons with Dave Arneson, shaping its classes, monsters, and dungeon-delving structure that defined modern tabletop RPGs.

Also known as: E. Gary Gygax, Gygax.
